notes: History schema expanded for future analysis: exact source/collection/ingestion times, all Bazaar products, weighted prices, top-level liquidity and 1%/5% market depth.
30-day raw history now rolls into hourly history, then into a permanent daily archive instead of being discarded.
Dual sync is faster and automatic desktop-triggered sync no longer blocks on the whole laptop transfer.
Full database handoff now preserves v0.5.9 metadata, liquidity fields and rollups.
Transient Bazaar aborts are retried with a safer minimum request timeout while hard errors still fail immediately.
Graceful shutdown stops timers, collection and sync, and a single-instance lock prevents duplicate BazaarFlipper servers.
